notes.title: OUR MIND PRIAVTE BETA UPDATE 2.5
notes.content:
[u][b][/b][/u]CHANGES:
-Fixed Issues where Rictor could be seen upon entering your party.
-Fixed Issues with attacks not working in the second scripted fight.
-Added optional tutorial for battle mechanics and movement mechanics
-Added more interactable elements and more flavour texts
-Added three new areas that can be explored with slight lore and dialogue added
-Updated the battle UI to be more streamlined and appealing
-Updated battle indicators (Sprites now reflect HP levels)
-Updated all Icons within the game to be originals rather than RPGMAKER pre-sets
